title: Spin-force from a Nitrogen-Vacancy ensemble drives a 100 mg levitated resonator
summary: The force experienced by a spin in a magnetic field gradient underlies many proposals for hybrid quantum systems. These include schemes for mechanically mediated quantum gates, spin squeezing, searches for exotic forces, and motional superpositions for probing the interface between quantum and gravity. Yet, experimentally observing this spin-force for anything larger than atomic scales has proved challenging. In our work, we demonstrate controllable Center-of-Mass motion of a $128 \rm\: mg$ diamagnetically levitated oscillator due to force from an ensemble of Nitrogen-Vacancy (NV) defects in…
